messages.text: The Canada Bilingual Wall Map is designed to hang on the wall, so for a floor-standing piece, I'd point you to our Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe. It's a large, hand-assembled, made-in-USA heirloom with a raised relief antique map that glows when lit, set on a handcrafted hardwood stand — a true centrepiece for a room. You'll find it under that exact name in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
